description: Free, no sign-in. The figures on BusinessRateChecker's overpayment map for England and Wales (2026 rating lists): properties analysed, properties flagged by our checks as paying too much, % flagged, '1 in N', median annual claim per flagged property, and the national indicative saving a year. With no area: England and Wales, England and Wales separately, and the 10 councils with the highest and lowest % flagged (country narrows these to England or Wales). With council or ba_code: up to 10 matching councils, each with its rank out of 318 (and within its country). Properties at or below the small business rate relief level (rateable value 12,000 GBP England, 6,000 GBP Wales) count one third. Same figures as https://businessratechecker.com/intelligence/map and its CSV. Each council and national block also carries win_rates: the Valuation Office's own statistics on how many resolved Checks and Challenges cut the rateable value, per rating list (2017 England only, 2023, 2026).

ba_code.description: VO billing-authority code (e.g. '4720') or ONS code (e.g. 'E08000035').

council.description: Council name or part of it, e.g. 'Leeds' or 'Cardiff'.

country.description: england or wales. Rank councils within England or Wales only. Omit for both.

include.description: Optional extra sections for the answer. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.include_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored. Leave out unless the user asks for something the normal answer lacks.

options.description: Optional extra settings by name. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.options_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored.

name: get_overpayment_map
title: Overpayment map figures
